Task: Put the red cube into the red tray and the blue cube into the blue tray.

Skill code (numbered):
  1| # skill module
  2| import math
  3| import numpy as np
  4| 
  5| def run(robot):
  6|     """
  7|     Sort red cube into red tray and blue cube into blue tray.
  8|     Returns True if both cubes are successfully placed.
  9|     """
 10|     # Helper: get pose with safe fallback
 11|     def safe_pose(name):
 12|         try:
 13|             return robot.get_pose(name)
 14|         except LookupError:
 15|             # object hidden; try to move gripper away and re‑observe later
 16|             return None
 17| 
 18|     # Main loop runs until both cubes are placed or we give up after a few attempts
 19|     placed = {"red": False, "blue": False}
 20|     attempts = 0
 21|     max_attempts = 30   # safety bound (≈ 3 s at 10 Hz)
 22| 
 23|     while not all(placed.values()) and attempts < max_attempts:
 24|         attempts += 1
 25|         robot.log(f"Attempt {attempts}")
 26|         obs = robot.observe()
 27|         objs = obs.get("objects", {})
 28|         fixtures = obs.get("fixtures", {})
 29| 
 30|         # Identify cubes and matching trays by colour
 31|         cube_info = {}
 32|         for name, data in objs.items():
 33|             if data["shape"] == "cube":
 34|                 cube_info[data["color"]] = {"pose": data["pos"], "yaw": data["yaw"], "name": name}
 35| 
 36|         tray_pos = {}
 37|         for name, data in fixtures.items():
 38|             if data["kind"] == "tray":
 39|                 tray_pos[data["color"]] = data["pos"]
 40| 
 41|         # Process each colour that has both cube and tray
 42|         for colour in ("red", "blue"):
 43|             if placed[colour]:
 44|                 continue
 45|             cube = cube_info.get(colour)
 46|             tray = tray_pos.get(colour)
 47|             if not cube or not tray:
 48|                 # missing object or tray – skip this iteration
 49|                 continue
 50| 
 51|             # -------- Pick up the cube ----------
 52|             # Target pose: align gripper with cube yaw, go slightly above centre
 53|             target_x, target_y = cube["pose"][0], cube["pose"][1]
 54|             # Add a small offset to avoid colliding with the table edge
 55|             offset = 0.015
 56|             target_z = cube["pose"][2] + offset
 57|             # Use a low speed for precise approach
 58|             approach_speed = 0.07
 59| 
 60|             # Compute a safe approach point a little forward in the gripper direction
 61|             # (gripper points along world yaw; we want to close towards the cube faces)
 62|             gripper_yaw = cube["yaw"]  # align closing direction with cube orientation
 63|             dx = math.cos(gripper_yaw) * 0.02   # 2 cm forward
 64|             dy = math.sin(gripper_yaw) * 0.02
 65|             approach_x = target_x + dx
 66|             approach_y = target_y + dy
 67| 
 68|             # Move to approach point
 69|             try:
 70|                 robot.log(f"Moving to approach {colour} cube at ({approach_x:.3f},{approach_y:.3f},{target_z:.3f})")
 71|                 resp = robot.move_to(approach_x, approach_y, target_z,
 72|                                      yaw=gripper_yaw,
 73|                                      speed=approach_speed)
 74|                 if not resp["ok"]:
 75|                     raise MotionError("blocked on approach")
 76|             except Exception as e:
 77|                 robot.log(f"Approach failed: {e}")
 78|                 continue   # retry next attempt
 79| 
 80|             # Lower a bit more to make contact
 81|             contact_z = cube["pose"][2] + 0.005   # just touch the top
 82|             try:
 83|                 robot.log("Descending to contact")
 84|                 resp = robot.move_to(approach_x, approach_y, contact_z,
 85|                                      yaw=gripper_yaw,
 86|                                      speed=0.05)
 87|                 if not resp["ok"]:
 88|                     raise MotionError("blocked on contact")
 89|             except Exception as e:
 90|                 robot.log(f"Contact move failed: {e}")
 91|                 continue
 92| 
 93|             # Close fingers
 94|             robot.log("Closing grasp")
 95|             if not robot.grasp():
 96|                 robot.log("Grasp failed, retry")
 97|                 # Release any partial hold and retry
 98|                 robot.release()
 99|                 continue
100| 
101|             # Verify hold
102|             held = robot.holding()
103|             if held != cube["name"]:
104|                 robot.log(f"Holding check failed: expected {cube['name']}, got {held}")
105|                 robot.release()
106|                 continue
107| 
108|             # -------- Move to target tray ----------
109|             # Target above tray centre, then lower to release height
110|             tray_x, tray_y = tray[0], tray[1]
111|             release_z = 0.015   # just above tray floor (cube centre at 0.015)
112|             # Align gripper orientation with tray colour (no special yaw needed)
113|             release_yaw = None
114| 
115|             # Move to above tray
116|             try:
117|                 robot.log(f"Moving to release zone over {colour} tray at ({tray_x:.3f},{tray_y:.3f},{release_z+0.02:.3f})")
118|                 resp = robot.move_to(tray_x, tray_y, release_z + 0.02,
119|                                      yaw=release_yaw,
120|                                      speed=0.07)
121|                 if not resp["ok"]:
122|                     raise MotionError("blocked on tray approach")
123|             except Exception as e:
124|                 robot.log(f"Tray approach failed: {e}")
125|                 continue
126| 
127|             # Lower to release height
128|             try:
129|                 robot.log("Lowering to release height")
130|                 resp = robot.move_to(tray_x, tray_y, release_z,
131|                                      yaw=release_yaw,
132|                                      speed=0.05)
133|                 if not resp["ok"]:
134|                     raise MotionError("blocked on release descent")
135|             except Exception as e:
136|                 robot.log(f"Release descent failed: {e}")
137|                 continue
138| 
139|             # Open fingers to release cube
140|             robot.log("Releasing cube")
141|             robot.release()
142| 
143|             # Verify release (optional)
144|             if robot.holding() is not None:
145|                 robot.log("Release check failed, retry")
146|                 # Try a small lift and release again
147|                 robot.move_to(tray_x, tray_y, release_z + 0.02, yaw=release_yaw, speed=0.07)
148|                 robot.release()
149| 
150|             # Mark colour as placed
151|             placed[colour] = True
152|             robot.log(f"Successfully placed {colour} cube")
153| 
154|         # Small pause to let simulation settle
155|         robot.wait(0.2)
156| 
157|     # Final result
158|     success = all(placed.values())
159|     robot.log(f"Skill finished, success={success}")
160|     return success
